evidence.explanation: JS alignment helper delegates to injected rn2 through fillEnvironment. It explicitly preserves repeated evaluation of C Align2amask(noncoalignment(...)); these edges are not omitted or extra alignment draws in the tested altar path.
evidence.proof: 12 comparisons: lawful Knight, neutral Tourist, chaotic Barbarian × two seeds × coaligned/noncoaligned public altar initialization. Exact C noncoalignment/sp_amask_to_amask plus unchanged Align2amask macro match stored JS altar masks and shared draw-tape consumption. Noncoaligned uses two or three draws; coaligned uses none. Mask 3 in one sequence is a demonstrated matching C macro result, not independently corrected behavior.
evidence.control: Coaligned requests for all three alignments consume zero draws; target covers two- and three-draw noncoaligned sequences. No priests are constructed.
